items.title: AFCS: The Flight Control Stack
items.description: How the AW169's Automatic Flight Control System is built up layer by layer, followed through a real departure and approach to show how the modes actually work together in flight.

items.title: TCAS II: Vertical Escape Geometry
items.description: How TCAS II actually thinks, followed through a real traffic encounter from first contact to clear of conflict.

items.title: Limitations: Flown as a Sortie
items.description: Every operating limit taken in the order you meet it, from certification through to the baggage bay.
